-- Faturamentos de abril/2026 da Mascote no tenant 60002
SELECT id, data, cat1, cat2, cat3, cat4, cat5, lancadoPor,
       (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5) AS total_dia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE tenantId = 60002
  AND empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
  AND data >= '2026-04-01'
  AND data <= '2026-04-30'
ORDER BY data;

-- Meta de abril/2026 da Mascote no tenant 60002
SELECT mes, ano, metaMensal, metaQuinzenal, diasUteis, diasUteisQuinzenal
FROM metas
WHERE tenantId = 60002
  AND empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
  AND mes = 4
  AND ano = 2026;

-- Totais gerais de abril/2026
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dias_lancados,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5) AS total_faturado,
  SUM(cat1) AS total_cat1,
  SUM(cat2) AS total_cat2,
  SUM(cat3) AS total_cat3,
  SUM(cat4) AS total_cat4,
  SUM(cat5) AS total_cat5
FROM faturamentos
WHERE tenantId = 60002
  AND empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
  AND data >= '2026-04-01'
  AND data <= '2026-04-30';
